answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 159624 Country: India Title: How to clean impure clothes? Question: I want to know if I mixed my washed or paak clothes with napaak clothes or if I touch the paak clothes in the condition of janabat or after hambistari with my wife. Will the paak or washed clothes remain paak? Please reply me. Answer ID: 159624 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 784/678/H=6/1439) (1) It is better to remove the impurity first from the impure clothes and then wash it together and if you wash them together and the impurity was removed from both types of clothes then too all the clothes became pure. (2) In the state of janabat, impurity is unseen thus if a junubi person touches clothes then they shall not turn impure, however if the semen is smeared in the hands and that was smeared in the cloth etc then in such a case that part of the cloth shall become impure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
